name: ID Generator Backend
description: Express and MongoDB API for the MERN ID card generator.

NODE_ENV.description: Runs the backend with production-only behavior.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string for the ID Generator database.

AUTH_SECRET.description: Long random secret used to sign admin auth tokens.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Shared secret sent by the Google Apps Script webhook.

CLIENT_URL.description: Primary deployed frontend URL, for example https://your-frontend.vercel.app.

CLIENT_URLS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed frontend URLs.

BACKGROUND_REMOVAL_ENABLED.description: Set true to enable server-side background removal. Set false as an emergency kill switch on small dynos.

GOOGLE_FORM_REMOVE_BG.description: Set true to remove backgrounds from Google Form photos when background removal is enabled.

BG_REMOVAL_FALLBACK_ENABLED.description: Use a fast solid-background fallback if ML removal is too slow or unavailable.

BG_REMOVAL_MODEL.description: Background-removal ML model size. Use small on Heroku.

BG_REMOVAL_MAX_DIMENSION.description: Resize photo before background removal to keep Heroku processing under the request timeout.

BG_REMOVAL_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum ML worker time before falling back to the fast solid-color remover.

GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID.description: Google Drive folder ID where generated assets are stored.

GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client ID for Drive uploads.

GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google OAuth client secret for Drive uploads.

GOOGLE_DRIVE_REDIRECT_URI.description: OAuth redirect URI used while generating the Drive refresh token.

GOOGLE_DRIVE_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Google OAuth refresh token for the Drive account.
